data.comment: {0} is the numeric id of the object type.

data.name: ObjectTypeBuiltInCannotRename
data.value: Cannot rename or re-icon built-in Metaverse Object Type '{0}'.

data.name: ObjectTypeNameExists

data.name: AttributeNameRequired
data.value: A Metaverse Attribute name is required.

data.name: AttributeNotFound
data.value: Metaverse Attribute {0} not found.
data.comment: {0} is the numeric id of the attribute.

data.name: AttributeBuiltInCannotRename
data.value: Cannot rename built-in Metaverse Attribute '{0}'.

data.name: AttributeNameExists
data.value: A Metaverse Attribute named '{0}' already exists (names are compared case-insensitively).

data.name: AttributeRenameReadByExpressions
data.value: Metaverse Attribute '{0}' cannot be renamed while Expressions read it by name. Change these first: {1}.
data.comment: {1} lists the Expressions that read the attribute, separated by semicolons.

data.name: StandardMappingNeedsStandard
data.value: Every Standard Mapping requires a standard.

data.name: StandardMappingNeedsCounterpart
data.value: Every Standard Mapping requires a counterpart attribute name.

data.name: StandardMappingDuplicate
data.value: Duplicate Standard Mapping: {0} '{1}'.
data.comment: {0} is the standard (a name such as Ldap); {1} is the counterpart attribute name.

data.name: StandardMappingsBuiltInCannotModify
data.value: Cannot modify the Standard Mappings of built-in Metaverse Attribute '{0}'; they are maintained by JIM.

data.name: BindingsBuiltInCannotModify
data.value: Cannot modify the bindings of built-in Metaverse Attribute '{0}'.

data.name: AttributeBuiltInCannotDelete
data.value: Cannot delete built-in Metaverse Attribute '{0}'.

data.name: AttributeBuiltInCannotUnassign
data.value: Cannot unassign built-in Metaverse Attribute '{0}'.

data.name: AttributeBuiltInCannotChangeType
data.value: Cannot change the type or plurality of built-in Metaverse Attribute '{0}'.

data.name: AttributePluralityUnsupported
data.value: A {0} attribute cannot be {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the data type name and {1} the plurality name, both shown as the identifiers JIM uses.

data.name: MultiValuedBooleanRule
data.value: A Boolean attribute holds one value, true or false, so it cannot be multi-valued.
data.comment: Must stay equal to AttributeDataTypeCapabilities.MultiValuedBooleanRule; a test pins it.

data.name: ChangeSearchTimeRangeInverted
data.value: The time range ends before it starts.

data.name: ChangeSearchTooManyConditions
data.value: A search can combine at most {0} attribute conditions.
data.comment: {0} is the maximum number of conditions.

data.name: ChangeSearchOperatorUnknown
data.value: '{0}' is not a recognised attribute change operator.

data.name: ChangeSearchAttributeUnknown
data.value: There is no Metaverse Attribute with id {0}.

data.name: ChangeSearchConditionInvalid
data.comment: {0} is the attribute name; {1} says why its value cannot be searched for.

data.name: ChangeSearchMatchModeUnknown
data.value: '{0}' is not a recognised condition match mode.

data.name: FeatureDisabled
data.value: The '{0}' feature is currently disabled.

data.name: FeatureFlagNotFound
data.value: No feature flag with key '{0}' exists.

data.name: FeatureInDevelopment
data.value: '{0}' is an in-development feature (tracked for removal in issue #{1}). It can only be enabled outside Development by passing allowInDevelopment.
data.comment: {1} is an issue number. allowInDevelopment is a parameter name and stays as it is.

data.name: CertificateThumbprintExists
data.value: A certificate with thumbprint {0} already exists in the store.

data.name: CertificateFileNotFound
data.value: Certificate file not found: {0}

data.name: CertificateNotFound
data.value: Certificate with ID {0} not found.

data.name: CertificateTrustPurposeRequired
data.value: A certificate must be trusted for Connectors, sign-in, or both.

data.name: SecureEndpointSystemNotFound
data.value: Connected System {0} was not found.
data.comment: {0} is the numeric id of the Connected System.

data.name: SecureEndpointNoConnectorDefinition
data.value: The '{0}' Connected System has no Connector Definition, so JIM cannot tell where it connects.

data.name: SecureEndpointConnectorUnavailable
data.value: The '{0}' connector is not available, so JIM cannot tell where this Connected System connects.

data.name: SecureEndpointConnectorNotEncrypted
data.value: The '{0}' connector does not make encrypted connections, so there is no server certificate to look at.

data.name: SecureEndpointNotConfigured
data.value: The '{0}' Connected System is not configured to make an encrypted connection, so there is no server certificate to look at.

data.name: ServerCertificateUnreachable
data.value: {0}:{1} could not be reached, so JIM could not read its certificate. This is a connectivity problem rather than a certificate one.
data.comment: {0} is a host name and {1} a port number.

data.name: SettingNotFound
data.value: Setting with key '{0}' not found.

data.name: SettingReadOnly
data.value: Setting '{0}' is read-only and cannot be modified.

data.name: IdpThumbprintRequired
data.value: A thumbprint is required. JIM will not trust whatever the identity provider happens to be presenting.

data.name: IdpNotConfigured
data.value: No identity provider is configured (JIM_SSO_AUTHORITY).

data.name: IdpNoAnswer
data.value: no answer

data.name: IdpUnreachable
data.value: JIM could not reach the identity provider at {0}: {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a host name; {1} is the error, or "no answer".

data.name: IdpPlainHttp
data.value: The identity provider at {0} is reached over plain HTTP, so there is no certificate to check. Use HTTPS outside local development.

data.name: IdpConfigurationUnreadable
data.value: JIM reached {0} but could not read its OpenID Connect configuration: {1}.

data.name: IdpNameMismatch
data.value: {0}'s certificate was not issued for {0}. Trusting a certificate cannot fix this: the identity provider needs a certificate that names {0}, or JIM_SSO_AUTHORITY must use a name its certificate carries.

data.name: IdpUntrusted
data.value: JIM does not trust {0}'s certificate: its chain ends at "{1}", and nothing trusted for sign-in vouches for it. Trust that certificate authority for sign-in to enable sign-in.

data.name: IdpUntrustedIssuedBy
data.value: JIM does not trust {0}'s certificate: its chain ends at "{1}" (issued by "{2}"), and nothing trusted for sign-in vouches for it. Trust that certificate authority for sign-in to enable sign-in.

data.name: IdpNoTlsCertificate
data.value: JIM reached {0} but it presented no TLS certificate: {1}.

data.name: IdpTrustedConfigurationUnreadable
data.value: JIM trusts {0}'s certificate but could not read its OpenID Connect configuration: {1}. Check JIM_SSO_AUTHORITY.

data.name: IdpTrustedByOperatingSystem
data.value: {0}'s certificate is trusted by the operating system.

data.name: IdpTrustedByStore
data.value: {0}'s certificate is trusted through the JIM certificate store ({1}).

data.name: IdpNothingTrusted
data.value: Nothing was trusted. {0}

data.name: IdpNotPresenting
data.value: {0} is not presenting a certificate with that thumbprint now, so nothing was trusted. This is expected if its certificate was renewed since you looked; check its status again.

data.name: IdpAlreadyTrusted
data.value: '{0}' is already trusted for sign-in.

data.name: IdpWouldNotVouch
data.value: Trusting '{0}' would not make {1} trusted: a certificate in its chain has expired or is not valid. Nothing was trusted; the identity provider's certificate needs renewing.

data.name: IdpWidenedToSignIn
data.value: '{0}' was already trusted for Connectors and is now trusted for sign-in as well.

data.name: IdpNowTrusted
data.value: '{0}' is now trusted for sign-in.

data.name: SchedBuiltInCannotDelete
data.value: The built-in schedule '{0}' cannot be deleted.

data.name: SchedStepsCannotBeAdded
data.value: Steps cannot be added to the built-in schedule '{0}'.

data.name: SchedStepsCannotBeChanged
data.value: Steps cannot be changed on the built-in schedule '{0}'.

data.name: SchedStepsCannotBeRemoved
data.value: Steps cannot be removed from the built-in schedule '{0}'.

data.name: SchedStartFailedStep
data.value: The Schedule could not start. Step {0} could not be queued: {1}. No steps ran.
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based step number; {1} is the reason the step could not be queued.

data.name: SchedStartFailedStepNamed
data.value: The Schedule could not start. Step {0}, {1}, could not be queued: {2}. No steps ran.
data.comment: {0} is the 1-based step number; {1} names what the step runs; {2} is the reason the step could not be queued.
